credits.title: Lilo & Scratch
credits.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

credits.title: Paperman
credits.overview: An urban office worker finds that paper airplanes are instrumental in meeting a girl in ways he never expected.

credits.title: Winnie the Pooh
credits.overview: During an ordinary day in Hundred Acre Wood, Winnie the Pooh sets out to find some honey. Misinterpreting a note from Christopher Robin, Owl convinces Pooh, Tigger, Rabbit, Piglet, Kanga, Roo, and Eeyore that their young friend has been captured by a creature named "Backson" and they set out to rescue him.
